facts.statement: Scutellosaurus is one of the earliest known representatives of armored dinosaurs and the most basal form discovered to date.
facts.quote: It is one of the earliest representatives of the armored dinosaurs and the basalmost form discovered to date.

facts.statement: The first skeletons of Scutellosaurus were found in June 1971 by David Lawler, an intern at the Museum of Northern Arizona.
facts.quote: The first skeletons of ornithischians from the Kayenta Formation were found in June 1971 by David Lawler, at the time an intern at the Museum of Northern Arizona.

facts.statement: The species name 'lawleri' honors David Lawler, the discoverer of the holotype, while the genus name 'Scutellosaurus' means 'little shield lizard'.
facts.quote: Colbert gave the new genus and species binomial Scutellosaurus lawleri to this armored ornithischian - MNA.V.175 as its holotype - with the genus name derived from the Latin scutellum, a little shield, and Greek σαῦρος (sauros), a lizard or reptile, and the species name in honour of the discoverer of the holotype, Lawler.

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus is the most abundant dinosaur species known from the Kayenta Formation.
facts.quote: The extensive specimens have made Scutellosaurus the most abundant dinosaur from the Kayenta Formation.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen includes over 300 osteoderms, numerous vertebrae, limb bones, and partial skull fragments.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen was described by Edwin Colbert (1981) based on the following: partially preserved premaxillae with teeth, a right maxilla with seven teeth, a left maxilla with five teeth, dentaries that are missing their posterior portions, a left dentary with 18 teeth, a right dentary with 10 teeth, other skull fragments, 21 presacral vertebral centra, several complete and partial neural arches and spines, five sacral vertebrae, 58 caudal vertebrae with neural arches and several chevrons, several incomplete ribs, both scapulae, both coracoids, partially preserved ilia, fragments of the pubic bones and of the ischia, both humeri, the distal end of the right radius, the proximal and distal ends of the left radius and ulna, fragments of the manus, both femora, the right tibia, the proximal end of the right fibula, the right astragalus, the left tibia, the left fibula, various bones of the pedes, including a possible distal tarsal bone, and over 300 osteoderms.

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus had an unusually long tail, likely serving as a counterbalance to its armored body.
facts.quote: It had an unusually long tail, possibly to provide a counterbalance against the weight of the armored body.

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus possessed several hundred osteoderms arranged in up to five parallel rows on each side, running from the neck to the tail.
facts.quote: There were several hundred osteoderms running along its neck to its back and as far down as its tail. These formed parallel rows, with as many as five rows on each side. It also had double rows of osteoderms, or external plates, running neck to tail.

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus serves as the nominal genus for the clade Scutellosauridae, a group coined in 1990.
facts.quote: Scutellosaurus has also been designated as the nominal genus for the clade Scutellosauridae, coined in 1990 by Lambert.

facts.statement: Fossils of Scutellosaurus are found in the Kayenta Formation, which is exposed on the Navajo Nation land in northern Arizona.
facts.quote: These are exposed on the land of the Navajo Nation in northern Arizona, forming a steep line of cliffs with little surface for prospecting.

facts.statement: The genus Scutellosaurus was named by Colbert in 1981.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Colbert, 1981

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus lived approximately 196 million years ago during the Early Jurassic Hettangian stage in what is now North America.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 196 millones de años, en el Hettangiense, en lo que hoy es Norteamérica

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus was about 1.3 meters long, 50 centimeters high, and weighed 3 kilograms.
facts.quote: Scutellosaurus alrededor de 1,3 metro de largo y 50 centímetros de alto, pesando 3 kilogramos

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus had an unusually long tail, possibly to counterbalance the weight of its armored body.
facts.quote: Tenía una cola inusualmente larga, posiblemente para contrarrestar el peso del cuerpo blindado

facts.statement: Hundreds of osteoderms were distributed along the neck, back, and as far as the tail tip.
facts.quote: Había también varios cientos de osteodermos que se distribuían a lo largo de su cuello, lomo y tan lejos como el extremo de la cola

facts.statement: Some of the armor plates were flat while others were marked with holes.
facts.quote: Algunos de estos escudos eran planos, mientras que otros estaban marcados con hoyos

facts.statement: Its long arms suggest it may have fed on all fours.
facts.quote: los brazos largos que sugieren pudieron haberse alimentado en cuatro patas

facts.statement: It had wide incisors and a row of leaf-shaped, striated cheek teeth adapted for eating plants.
facts.quote: Tenía varios incisivos amplios y una fila de los dientes en la mejilla foliformes y estriados que aparecen haber estado adaptados para alimentarse de plantas

facts.statement: The tail was extremely long, occupying two-thirds of the body length.
facts.quote: La cola es extremadamente larga, ocupando dos tercios de la longitud del cuerpo

facts.statement: The armor on Scutellosaurus is estimated to have constituted only one-tenth of its total body weight.
facts.quote: Se estima que la proporción sería sólo una décima parte

facts.statement: Fossil evidence includes several partial skeletons recovered from Arizona by the Museum of Northern Arizona and the University of California Museum of Paleontology.
facts.quote: La evidencia fósil incluye varios esqueletos parciales recuperados de Arizona por el Museo del Norte de Arizona y el Museo de Paleontología de la Universidad de California

facts.statement: Its skull measured about 9 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: Su cráneo medía cerca de 9 cm de longitud

facts.statement: Colbert believed the animal could walk optionally on all fours.
facts.quote: Colbert creía que el animal podía caminar opcionalmente a cuatro patas

facts.statement: Later researchers doubted Colbert's hypothesis that the animal could walk on all fours.
facts.quote: Aunque los investigadores posteriores dudarían de eso nuevamente

facts.statement: In 2008, Richard Butler identified two distinguishing features: the anterior iliac laminae extend forward while folding into each other, and the tail consists of at least fifty-eight vertebrae.
facts.quote: En 2008, Richard Butler dio dos autapomorfias: las láminas anteriores del ilion se extienden hacia adelante mientras se doblan una hacia la otra; la cola consta de al menos cincuenta y ocho vértebras

facts.statement: Additional distinguishing features were identified in 2020.
facts.quote: Se identificaron autapomorfias adicionales en 2020

facts.statement: Four more distinguishing features were added in 2021.
facts.quote: En 2021, se agregaron cuatro autapomorfias más

facts.statement: Another possible distinguishing feature is the possession of six premaxillary teeth, though this has not been found in a fossil.
facts.quote: Otra posible autapomorfia es la posesión de seis dientes premaxilares

facts.statement: Colbert originally reconstructed the skull as quite convex, assuming it was a "primitive" ornithischian.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Scutellosaurus fue reconstruido originalmente bastante convexo por Colbert, asumiendo que era un ornitisquio "primitivo"

facts.statement: Today, the head is viewed as moderately elongated with a flat top and a pointed snout in lateral view.
facts.quote: Hoy en día, la cabeza se ve como moderadamente alargada con una parte superior plana y un hocico puntiagudo en la vista lateral

facts.statement: There are at least ten maxillary teeth.
facts.quote: Hay al menos diez dientes maxilares

facts.statement: It is believed there are eighteen dental teeth.
facts.quote: Se cree que hay dieciocho dientes dentales

facts.statement: The spine of Scutellosaurus consists of six or seven cervical vertebrae, seventeen or eighteen torso and back vertebrae, five sacral vertebrae, and about sixty tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: La columna vertebral del Scutellosaurus consta de seis o siete vértebras cervicales, diecisiete o dieciocho vértebras del torso y lomo, el número depende de si una vértebra cervicodorsal se llama vértebra o no, cinco vértebras sacras y unas sesenta vértebras caudales.

facts.statement: The tail was enormous, approximately two and a half times the length of the vertebrae situated in front of the sacrum.
facts.quote: La cola tiene una longitud enorme, aproximadamente dos veces y media la de las vértebras situadas delante del sacro.

facts.statement: Colbert found some ossified tendons, leading to the conclusion that the rear back and the base of the tail were hardened by them.
facts.quote: Colbert encontró algunos tendones osificados, de estos se puede concluir que la espalda trasera y la base de la cola se endurecían por esto.

facts.statement: The hand claws were small and pointed, without a hoof shape, indicating they were not used for walking.
facts.quote: Las garras de las manos son pequeñas y puntiagudas, sin forma de pezuña, una indicación de que no se pisaron.

facts.statement: The fourth trochanter, an attachment for the long caudofemoral muscle, was large and positioned slightly above the center of the axis, serving as an adaptation for high speed.
facts.quote: El cuarto trocánter, el accesorio para el músculo caudofemoral largo, es grande y caído, colocado ligeramente por encima del centro del eje, de nuevo una adaptación para alta velocidad.

facts.statement: The metatarsals were moderately long with their upper ends closely spaced in a hollow rear arch, typical of a running animal.
facts.quote: Los metatarsianos son moderadamente largos. Sus extremos superiores están estrechamente espaciados, colocados en un arco trasero hueco, típico de un animal que corre.

facts.statement: The upper phalanges had a deep groove on their lower upper surface to accommodate a superior projection of the second phalanges, indicating considerable freedom to extend the foot and allowing for a powerful push at high speed.
facts.quote: Las falanges superiores tienen un surco profundo en su superficie superior inferior para acomodar una proyección superior de las segundas falanges, lo que indica una libertad considerable para extender el pie, lo que permite un potente empuje a alta velocidad.

facts.statement: The genus name Scutellosaurus means "small-shelled lizard", derived from the Latin word "scutellum" meaning "small shield" and the Greek word "sauros" meaning "lizard".
facts.quote: El nombre del género Scutellosaurus significa "lagarto con escudo pequeño", y se deriva de la palabra latina "scutellum" que significa "escudo pequeño", y la palabra griega "sauros", σαύρα, que significa "lagarto".

facts.statement: The type and only valid species known today is Scutellosaurus lawleri, named in honor of David Lawler, who collected the fossil.
facts.quote: El tipo y la única especie válida que se conoce hoy en día es Scutellosaurus lawleri, El nombre específico honra a David Lawler, quien recogió el fósil.

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus belongs to the parent group Thyreophora.
facts.quote: Parent group: Thyreophora

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Scutellosaurus lived from the Hettangian to the Pliensbachian stages, between 201.4 and 184.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Pliensbachian (201.4 to 184.2 million years ago)
